mapper.select: SELECT c.province_name, p.center_lon, p.center_lat, #{year} AS year, #{month} AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.city_code) AS city_count, ROUND(AVG(m.price), 2) AS avg_price, MIN(m.price) AS min_price, MAX(m.price) AS max_price, ROUND(STDDEV(m.price), 2) AS stddev_price, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.price)::numeric, 2) AS median_price FROM t_monthly_price m JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = m.city_code LEFT JOIN t_province p ON p.province_name = c.province_name WHERE m.year = #{year} AND m.month = #{month} AND m.price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.province_name, p.center_lon, p.center_lat ORDER BY avg_price DESC

SELECT c.province_name, p.center_lon, p.center_lat, #{year} AS year, #{month} AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT c.city_code) AS city_count, ROUND(AVG(m.price), 2) AS avg_price, MIN(m.price) AS min_price, MAX(m.price) AS max_price, ROUND(STDDEV(m.price), 2) AS stddev_price, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.price)::numeric, 2) AS median_price FROM t_monthly_price m JOIN t_city c ON c.city_code = m.city_code LEFT JOIN t_province p ON p.province_name = c.province_name WHERE c.province_name = #{provinceName} AND m.year = #{year} AND m.month = #{month} AND m.price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.province_name, p.center_lon, p.center_lat
